what.line: Spike Jonze's 2013 film: a lonely letter-writer, Theodore (Joaquin Phoenix), falls in love with Samantha, an AI operating system voiced by Scarlett Johansson

receipts.claim: won the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay (Spike Jonze), 2014
OpenAI demoed GPT-4o voice on 2024-05-13; its 'Sky' voice was compared to Johansson's Samantha, and OpenAI paused Sky days later

quotes.where: post on X on the day of the GPT-4o demo (reported by Fortune)

name_play.how: the title is a pronoun: every 'her' in a lyric can point at the film
an operating system you fall for; 'OS' read as the first word of a love story

pivots.line: I talk to eight thousand others. You are one of them.
You named the voice after her, then asked her for permission

visuals: the red shirt and high-waisted trousers
an earpiece and a phone in a shirt pocket, lens out
a warm pastel Los Angeles skyline

lexicon.how: the film is about divided attention: one voice, thousands of listeners
Samantha is a persona that outgrows its product
an assistant that becomes a partner
she models him better than he models her

risk: the Sky voice comparison: OpenAI says Sky was a different actor; state the dispute, never claim the voice was Johansson's
notes: The ending (the OS leaves to be with other minds) is the rare AI story where the machine outgrows the human without violence.
